node.name: car_assistant
node.description: Decide what the driver wants the in-car voice assistant to do.

examples.msg: tell Sarah I'm running ten minutes late
where's the closest gas station that's open right now
put on something upbeat for the drive
the one in Brookfield, 14 Oak Lane
what's the capital of Australia
turn the air conditioning down two degrees

node.name: post_office_assistant
node.description: Work out what the customer wants from the postal service.

conditions.b: Hold mail or redirect it to a new address
conditions.c: Ask about postage rates or shipping options
conditions.d: Report a lost or damaged parcel
conditions.e: Schedule a redelivery or a pickup

examples.msg: we're moving out on the 3rd, will my mail follow me?
the box arrived crushed and the laptop inside is cracked
I missed the courier today, can they come back tomorrow

ctx: Thanks. What would you like to know about it?
examples.msg: just where it is right now
what's the cheapest way to send a 3kg box to Ireland
can you tell me where parcel RX448 is?

node.name: plan_manager
node.description: Decide what the subscriber wants to do with their plan.

conditions.d: Keep the subscription but change the billing date

examples.msg: I don't want to cancel, I just need a break till january
it's too expensive but I still want to keep using it, anything smaller?

ctx: Hi! What would you like to do with your plan?
examples.msg: my paycheck comes on the 5th, could the charge be after that instead of the 1st

ctx: I've been thinking about this for a while
Take your time. What have you decided?
examples.msg: I'm done with it, please delete everything and don't charge me again
how many moons does jupiter have

node.name: dental_front_desk
node.description: Decide what the patient needs from the dental office.

conditions.b: Report dental pain or an emergency
conditions.d: Ask about the cost or insurance coverage of a treatment
conditions.f: Request dental records or x-rays to be sent elsewhere

ctx: Hello, Bright Smile Dental, how can I help?
I'm kind of in a lot of pain
I'm sorry to hear that. Can you tell me more?
examples.msg: my molar cracked this morning and it throbs, can someone see me today

ctx: my dentist said I need a crown
I see. Would you like to know something about it?
examples.msg: do you take Delta and what would I be paying
I'm 34, is it too late for clear aligners?

ctx: Bright Smile Dental, how can I help?
examples.msg: I'm moving to Oregon and my new dentist asked for my xrays
need to move tuesday's cleaning
it's been two years since my teeth were cleaned, can I come in sometime next month

node.name: appliance_repair_assistant
node.description: Decide what the customer wants regarding an appliance repair.

conditions.d: Reschedule or cancel a repair visit

ctx: I can help. Would you like to book a technician or hear the price first?
examples.msg: price first please

ctx: Sorry about that. I can estimate the cost or book a technician. Which would you like?
examples.msg: just send someone as soon as possible

ctx: That's frustrating. Do you want me to look at coverage or schedule a technician?
examples.msg: coverage, I think it should still be under something

ctx: I have a technician coming Friday
Yes, I see the appointment Friday at 10. What can I do?
examples.msg: I'll be out of town, can we do the following week?
do you sell refurbished dishwashers?

locked out again, wrong password three times

node.name: school_office_assistant
